chain_recipe.digest: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical JSON, lowercase hex
chain_recipe.input: { "v": <chain_version>, "links": [ <each link below that applies, in this order> ] }

version.rule: 4 when `approval` is present; else 3 when `payment.amount_authorized` is present; else 2 when `payment.amount_atomic` is not null; else 1

notes: `mandate.sig_sha256` is SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of `mandate.sig`, lowercase hex. A v4 chain seals it in place of `sig`, which must not be shared; v1-v3 seal `sig` itself, so only the tenant, whose read carries `sig`, can recompute those. Anyone can still verify their signature over `chain`.
Recomputing needs `quote.payee` unmasked. Whoever shares a receipt decides whether to hand it over.
Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds, exactly as read.
